summary: The IDF conducted strikes against Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon following an incident in Majdal Zoun that killed two soldiers. Concurrently, Iran is considering legislation to formalize control over the Strait of Hormuz, including prohibiting transit for hostile nations. Tensions remain high as US and Israeli joint missile defense testing is reportedly completed.
key_points: The IDF struck Hezbollah weapon depots, command centers, and infrastructure in southern Lebanon in response to an incident in Majdal Zoun (Source: @manniefabian/58940).
Two IDF reservists, Major (res.) Harel Birnstock and Sergeant Major (res.) Tamir Waknin, were killed in an explosion in Majdal Zoun (Source: @almogboker78/17910).
Four IDF soldiers were seriously wounded during an operation when a Hezbollah explosive device detonated in a building (Source: @almogboker78/17910).
Iran is considering a bill to prohibit vessels from the US and Israel from passing through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6120).
The US and Israel have completed a joint test of a missile defense system (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78873).
The IDF returned 15 Israeli civilians to Israel after they illegally crossed the border into Lebanon near Ghajar (Source: @manniefabian/58939).
Houthi forces launched a large-scale missile and drone operation against Saudi-backed forces in Marib and Hadramaut (Source: @presstv/201849).
At least 30 Saudi-backed soldiers were killed in Houthi attacks in Marib and Hadramaut provinces (Source: @asafroz/52297).

points: The Iranian parliament is considering a hardline bill to formalize control over the Strait of Hormuz, which would prohibit passage for vessels belonging to the US and Israel (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6120).
Proposed legislation includes banning all military and non-military cargoes associated with Israel or the Axis of Resistance from the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6120).
The proposed bill would impose financial penalties of up to 20% of total cargo value on violators of the new maritime regulations (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6120).
Iran is reportedly seeking revenge for five soldiers killed by Saudi forces in Iraq (Source: @kianmeli1/90693).
The IDF conducted strikes against Hezbollah weapon depots, command centers, and infrastructure in southern Lebanon in response to an incident in Majdal Zoun (Source: @manniefabian/58940).
Two IDF reservists, Major (res.) Harel Birnstock and Sergeant Major (res.) Tamir Waknin, were killed in an explosion in Majdal Zoun (Source: @almogboker78/17910).
Four IDF soldiers were seriously wounded when a Hezbollah explosive device detonated in a building during an operation (Source: @almogboker78/17910).
The Israeli security establishment has identified an increasing threat from advanced drone technology using fiber-optic connections to bypass electronic warfare (Source: @yediotnews25/133678).
The IDF returned 15 Israeli civilians to Israel after they illegally crossed the border into Lebanon near Ghajar (Source: @manniefabian/58939).
The IDF struck Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon, including weapon depots and command centers, following an incident in Majdal Zoun (Source: @manniefabian/58940).
A Hezbollah fighter was killed on a motorcycle in the town of Mayfadun in southern Lebanon (Source: @yediotnews25/133673).
Artillery shelling was reported in the area of Adshit al-Qusayr (Source: @redlinkleb/35071).
A car bomb exploded near the Al-Rawdah junction in the Jaramana district of Rif Dimashq Governorate, Syria (Source: @shin_persian/8857).
Intense military aircraft activity was reported over Baghdad, Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/8868).
Heavy helicopter flight activity was reported over the capital of Baghdad (Source: @naya_foriraq/87172).
Houthi forces carried out a large-scale missile and drone operation targeting military camps of Saudi-backed forces in Marib and Hadramaut (Source: @presstv/201849).
At least 30 Saudi-backed soldiers were killed in Houthi missile and drone attacks in Marib and Hadramaut provinces (Source: @asafroz/52297).
The Saudi-led coalition reported that 11 civilians, including a 4-year-old child, were injured in a Houthi attack (Source: @N12chat/220958).
Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan are expected to sign a joint defense agreement in Saudi Arabia (Source: @asafroz/52297).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by increased kinetic activity in southern Lebanon and Yemen. The potential for maritime escalation in the Strait of Hormuz is rising due to proposed Iranian legislation. Additionally, the emergence of fiber-optic guided drones presents a significant technical challenge to Israeli electronic warfare defenses.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are moving toward a joint defense agreement. The US continues to support regional security through naval blockades and missile defense cooperation with Israel.
sections.intelligence_notes: The death of two IDF reservists in Majdal Zoun indicates continued Hezbollah capability to execute successful ambushes. The use of fiber-optic drones suggests a shift in asymmetric warfare tactics designed to bypass standard jamming measures.
